shape: small things you did without thinking as a kid that take nerve now, each told as what you did, never as advice

slides.text: things we did at ten that take nerve now
walking up your front steps and knocking on the door without texting first to see if you were home.
asking 'do you want to be friends?' out loud before we even knew each other's last names.
opening your fridge to grab a juice box without asking anyone in the kitchen.
telling your mum i was staying for dinner before i even checked with my own.
saying [[i'm sorry]] five minutes after we flipped the board game across the rug.
promising we would buy two houses right next door to each other and never move away.
[[save this]] for the friend whose childhood phone number you still know by heart.

caption:
we spent whole summers together without ever having to make a plan.
now we look at each other's photos and wonder when we got so polite.
save this for an afternoon when you miss your childhood best friend.
alt: a reflective carousel about small, fearless habits childhood best friends shared that take courage to do as adults.
